info.name: Emerald Housing Society - Steps 1-8
info.description: Combined Society and Member API collection for Steps 1–7 plus Step 8 NGINX edge access. Use externalBaseUrl for normal HTTPS requests through NGINX Gateway Fabric, API Gateway, and backend services. First use Authentication: retrieve CSRF, log in, then retrieve a fresh CSRF token. Postman keeps SESSION and XSRF-TOKEN cookies for emerald.local. Direct societyBaseUrl, memberBaseUrl, and gatewayBaseUrl variables remain for diagnostics only.

item.name: Authentication - Step 7
item.description: Manual session login and CSRF workflow. No Postman scripts are added. The client cookie jar carries the HttpOnly SESSION cookie; copy CSRF response tokens manually.

request.description: Run before login and again after login. Copy the response token into the csrfToken environment variable. Postman should retain the XSRF-TOKEN cookie.

Log in with the privately provisioned administrator. Expected: 200 and minimal admin identity. Invalid credentials: 401. Do not save a real password in an exported collection/environment. Login rotates the session ID and clears the old CSRF token; fetch a new CSRF token after success.
Reads the current admin identity from the SESSION cookie. Expected: 200 when logged in; 401 without a valid session.
First clear cookies for localhost in Postman, then send this request. Expected: 401. Do not run while a valid SESSION cookie is present.
Run while logged in, with cookies present, but intentionally omit X-XSRF-TOKEN. Expected: 403 and no member is created.
End the current session. Run after fetching a fresh CSRF token. Expected: 200; subsequent Get Current Admin should return 401.
Returns Emerald Housing Society details. Expected: 200 OK with societyId, societyName, and totalFloors.
Returns the 18 floor records ordered from 1 to 18. Expected: 200 OK and an array of {"floorNumber": number} records.
Looks up the floor selected by the floorNumber environment variable. Values 1 through 18 return 200 OK; an integer outside that range returns 404.
Demonstrates a numeric floor outside the configured 1â€“18 range. Expected: 404 Not Found with code RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND and the common JSON error fields.
Direct diagnostic only. Health endpoints are intentionally not published through the NGINX external route; use the documented port-forward or kubectl health checks.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Creates an active member. Expected: 201 Created, a Location header, and a response containing the generated memberId, normalized fields, ACTIVE status, createdAt, and updatedAt. Manually copy memberId into the selected environment's memberId variable for later requests. The default mobile format is a 10-digit Indian number beginning 6â€“9; the number must not already belong to an active member.
Lists members persisted by Member Service in member_db. Expected: 200 OK and a JSON array; an empty database returns []. Results are ordered by creation time descending.
Retrieves the member whose UUID is stored in memberId. Expected: 200 OK with MemberResponse; 404 if that UUID is not present; 400 if it is not a valid UUID.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Replaces the permitted member fields. Expected: 200 OK. memberId and createdAt remain unchanged; updatedAt is server generated. Use an unused mobile number if changing it, or the same number currently owned by this member.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Logically deactivates the member and retains the record. Expected: 200 OK with status INACTIVE. Repeating the operation is idempotent and does not change updatedAt after the first transition.
Direct diagnostic only. Health endpoints are intentionally not published through the NGINX external route; use the documented port-forward or kubectl health checks.
Returns a PageResponse. Page is zero-based, size must be 1-100. Expected: 200.

item.name: Manual Error Scenarios
item.description: Run these scenarios manually and inspect the status and JSON body. Dependency outage scenarios require stopping Society Service yourself; requests do not control service processes.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Uses a value that does not match the default configured Indian mobile format. Expected: 400 Bad Request, code VALIDATION_FAILED, with a mobileNumber validation detail.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Supplies a malformed optional email value. Expected: 400 Bad Request, code VALIDATION_FAILED, with an email validation detail.

request.description: First create an active member with the environment's memberMobile value. Repeating that number for another active member returns 409 Conflict, code DUPLICATE_RESOURCE. After deactivation, that number can be reused by a newly created active member.
Uses a syntactically valid UUID that is not generated by this application. Expected: 404 Not Found, code RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.
Uses a path value that cannot be converted to UUID. Expected: 400 Bad Request, code INVALID_REQUEST.
Uses an integer outside the configured 1â€“18 floor range. Expected: 404 Not Found, code RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND. A non-integer path segment instead returns 400 Bad Request.

item.name: Phase 3 - Society Flat API
item.description: Society Service owns all flat records. Create a flat once, then copy flatId from its response. A flat number is selected by the developer; no arbitrary flat inventory is seeded.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Create a configured flat on a valid floor. Expected 201 with flatId, flatNumber, floorId, floorNumber and status. Duplicate flat numbers in this society return 409. Copy flatId into the environment for subsequent calls.
Lists configured flats, sorted by flat number. Expected 200 and an array. Empty flat inventory is valid.
The stable read contract used by Member Service. Expected 200 with flatId, flatNumber, floorId, floorNumber and status. Response echoes X-Correlation-ID.
Syntactically valid but unknown flat UUID. Expected 404 with the Society service's structured RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND error.
Invalid UUID path value. Expected 400 with a structured INVALID_REQUEST response.
Returns a PageResponse. Allowed sortBy values: flatNumber, status, createdAt, updatedAt. Expected: 200; invalid paging/sort gives 400.
Returns flats on the selected floor in flat-number order. Expected: 200; unknown floor gives 404.
Paginated/sorted flats on the selected floor. Expected: 200.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Updates the flat number and floor while preserving its ID and audit creation time. Expected: 200; invalid data 400; duplicate flat number 409.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Marks the flat INACTIVE and retains it for historical references. Repeated calls are idempotent. Expected: 200.

item.name: Phase 3 - Member Flat Membership
item.description: Member Service calls Society Service before saving membership. Create/select a member and create/select a flat first. Set correlationId to a safe value such as demo-assign-001.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Validates the member locally, calls Society GET /api/v1/flats/{flatId}, then writes locally. Expected 201 with membershipId/memberId/flatId/relationshipType/startDate. 404 if member or flat is missing, 409 for inactive member or duplicate relationship, 502/503/504 for dependency errors. A failed flat/dependency check is never persisted.
Lists membership history for the selected member. Expected 200 with an array of membership response records.
Lists membership records associated with this external flat UUID. Expected 200 with an array.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Run after a successful identical assignment. Expected 409 DUPLICATE_MEMBERSHIP. No extra active membership row is created.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Society Service returns 404, which Member Service maps to 404 FLAT_NOT_FOUND. No membership is saved.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Manual scenario: stop Society Service before sending. Expected 503 SOCIETY_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE and no membership write. Restart Society afterward. This request does not stop the service automatically.
Run while Society is stopped. Expected 200 from Member Service's own database; member retrieval does not call Society.
Returns member membership history in PageResponse form. Expected: 200; missing member 404.
Returns flat membership history in PageResponse form. Expected: 200.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Sets an end date and preserves the membership row. Use a date on/after startDate and not in the future. Repeated call retains the original end date. Expected: 200; invalid date 400; unknown member/membership 404.

item.name: Gateway - Step 6
item.description: The api-gateway Kubernetes Service is ClusterIP, so it is reachable directly by Pods inside the cluster as http://api-gateway:8080. Postman running on your computer is outside the cluster: first run `kubectl port-forward service/api-gateway 8080:8080 -n emerald-housing`, keep that terminal open, and set gatewayBaseUrl to http://localhost:8080. The tunnel is temporary; stop it with Ctrl+C. These requests preserve backend routes; direct Society/Member folders remain useful for local development or troubleshooting.

request.description: Direct diagnostic only. Health endpoints are intentionally not published through the NGINX external route; use the documented port-forward or kubectl health checks.
Routes to Society Service through Gateway. Expected: 200; X-Correlation-ID and the serving Society Pod X-Instance-ID are returned.

exec: pm.test('Gateway routes to Society Service', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Society instance ID is returned', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has('X-Instance-ID')).to.be.true; });

request.description: Routes Society flat inventory through Gateway. Expected: 200 with a JSON array.

exec: pm.test('Gateway routes flat list', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Response is a JSON array', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });

request.description: Creates a member through the member route. Expected: 201. A successful response updates memberId for the other Gateway requests.

exec: pm.test('Member created through Gateway', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });

request.description: Routes member retrieval to Member Service. Expected: 200 for a current memberId; 404 if it is stale or unknown.
Routes flat lookup to Society Service. Expected: 200 for a current flatId; 404 if it does not exist.

item.name: POST Assign Member to Flat Through Gateway

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Routes to Member Service; its RestClient then validates the flat through Society Service. Expected: 201 for valid IDs, 404 for missing member/flat, or a controlled dependency error if Society Service is unavailable.

exec: pm.test('Assignment status is successful or a documented API error', function () { pm.expect([201, 400, 404, 409, 502, 503, 504]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Routes to Member Service. Expected: 200 with membership history; use this after a successful assignment to confirm persistence.

item.name: NGINX Edge - Step 8
item.description: Manual demonstrations of NGINX Gateway Fabric HTTPS entry and HTTP redirect. Trust the local development certificate before sending requests.

request.description: Requires the documented local HTTP port-forward. Expected result is HTTP 308 to the matching HTTPS URL. Do not submit credentials over HTTP.
Calls the public NGINX HTTPS listener, then Spring Cloud Gateway, then Society Service. Sign in first using the Authentication folder when security is enabled.
